hero.title: Discover Sri Lanka's Most Iconic Attractions
hero.subline: From misty highland peaks to ancient UNESCO rock fortresses, enjoy total road trip freedom starting right from Kandy with Danan Rentals.

tips.title: Fuel Up Early
tips.desc: Hill country roads between Kandy and Nuwara Eliya or Ella have fewer fuel stations after sunset. Always keep your tank above half full.

tips.title: Mountain Driving Caution
tips.desc: Highland roads feature winding hairpin turns and sudden mist. Maintain lower gears on steep declines and keep headlights on in fog.

tips.title: Carry International Permit
tips.desc: Foreign travelers must carry an AA Ceylon endorsement or valid International Driving Permit alongside their passport at all times.

tips.title: 24/7 Danan Emergency Dispatch
tips.desc: Save our 24/7 WhatsApp emergency line (+94 77 201 3059) on your phone. We can dispatch replacement vehicles or roadside mechanical help islandwide.

cta.title: Planning Your Sri Lanka Itinerary?
cta.text: Speak directly with our local rental experts for personalized route recommendations, road conditions, and vehicle selection.
